title: How we sell homes like yours

pages.title: How we sell homes like yours
pages.body: A short book on how we present and market historic, architect-designed and one-of-a-kind homes, and how we find their next stewards.
pages.clip: the best room of a historic home in morning light

pages.title: Your home is a work of art. We market it like one.
pages.body:
We present a home the way a museum presents a work: carefully lit, carefully framed, with the details given room to be seen.

Then we go looking for its next stewards: the people who will love it and care for it as much as you have.

pages.title: Every home has a story. We research it.
pages.body:
The architect or builder, the year and style, the original owners, and what has changed and what has been kept.

That research becomes the house biography: a printed piece at every showing, a story on our site, and the backbone of everything we share.
pages.clip: archival photo of the house, then the house today

pages.title: Protect what makes it rare.
pages.body:
Some updates add value. Some erase the very thing buyers are looking for.

We help you decide which repairs matter, which original features to protect, and how to present the home so its craftsmanship reads first.
pages.clip: a hand on a restored newel post

pages.title: Editorial, not MLS.
pages.body:
Styled, editorial photography and short films of the details, the light and the rooms, shaped by Elena's background in film and advertising.

The goal is simple: make people feel what it is like to live there.
pages.clip: light moving across a room over an afternoon

pages.eyebrow: V. A campaign, not a launch
pages.title: Weeks of fresh angles.
pages.body:
Most listings get one week of attention, then wait. Yours gets a campaign: the reveal, the history, the details, the house through the seasons, and the neighborhood around it.

Each week gives its next stewards another reason to stop and look.
pages.clip: a sequence of details: tile, glass, hardware

pages.title: The right people, not just any buyer.
pages.body: We look for the people who will love this home and care for it. We reach them through our publication and newsletter, our neighborhoods, and the architects and design-builders we work with, along with every agent through the MLS.
pages.clip: a neighborhood street at golden hour

pages.title: A typical listing, and ours.
pages.body:
Bedrooms, baths and square footage → the house's story, its design and its makers.

A one-week launch → a multi-week campaign.

As many buyers as possible → its next stewards.

Original features called "dated" → original features presented as craftsmanship.

pages.title: Every sale gives back.
pages.body:
At closing, Quinby Partners gives $1,000 to a nonprofit you choose, from our side of the transaction and never added to your costs.

History, conservation and arts organizations are natural fits for homes like yours.
pages.clip: keys handed over on a front porch

pages.title: Thank you for reading.
pages.body:
[A short, personal note from Becky: why homes like this matter to you, and an invitation to talk whenever the owners are ready, whether that's this season or years from now.]

Becky Quinby, Founder and Broker
